The full moon day of Waso is the day that the Buddha preformed the Twin Miracle. This miracle consisted of the Buddha first growing a mango tree from a seed to be 50 cubits tall (this tree was later known as the Kandamba mango tree). Then the Buddha proceeded to emit fire from the upper half of his body and water from the lower half and vice versa. Even though the 2 forces repelled each other, they did not extingish each other to represent cosmic balance. Then the Buddha made a jewel path to the Tavatisma Heaven (along the way also preaching the Dhammha) where he intended to teach the spirit of his mother the higher philosophy of the Abhidhamma.
